entries.en: last year; the past year
entries.notes: L、M 栏有划删痕迹，但 L/H/R 所指一致（昨岁＝去年），照常收录。

entries.zh: 荒年；稻米歉收的饥荒之年
entries.en: a lean year; a year of rice crop failure (famine)

entries.zh: 饥馑；蔬菜歉收的荒年，泛指饥荒
entries.en: famine; a year of vegetable crop failure

entries.zh: 期年；周年；满一年（用以计岁计时）
entries.en: a full year; a whole year; the completion of a year's term
entries.notes: L 栏「acaber」「para todo dicen」文句讹误，义据 H「期年」（周年）与 R 定。

entries.en: next year; the coming year
entries.notes: L、M 栏部分残损，然 H「来年」与 R「lāy niên」互合，义可定。

entries.zh: 对年；年终岁首（旧岁已尽、新年到来，行祭祀之时）
entries.en: the turn of the year; year's end and the incoming year (a time of sacrifice)
entries.notes: L 述年终岁首行祭；按闽南「对年」亦指亡者周年祭，此处取岁末年初之义。

entries.en: before; formerly; years past
entries.notes: L 仅存「Años -」，与 H「前」义不侔，疑为「años ha」（多年前）之残文。

entries.en: the previous year; last year
entries.notes: L 作「el año pasado」（去年），与 H「前年」今义（前两年）微异，并存之。

entries.en: former times; formerly
at first; in the beginning
entries.notes: H 末字作「悴」，文义不通，据 L「al principio」定为「起初」。

entries.en: the front; the beginning; at first
entries.notes: H 末字作「悴」可疑；「前头」有起首、当头之义，与 L「al principio」相合。

entries.en: past events; former affairs
entries.notes: L 栏全残，仅据 H「前事」与 R「chêng sū」定。

entries.en: last time; previously; former days
entries.notes: R 作「fân」，可证 H 为「番」而非「昔」。

entries.en: a former dynasty; former times; antiquity
before and after; first and last

entries.zh: 寅时；天亮之前（约凌晨三至五时）
entries.en: the yin hour, before daybreak (3–5 a.m.)

entries.zh: 寅时；天亮前（约凌晨三至五时）
entries.en: the yin hour before dawn (3–5 a.m.)
entries.notes: L、M 栏有划删，义仍与 H「寅时」、R 相合。

entries.en: formerly; in the past; as usual

entries.zh: 宁死不辱；宁可受死，不受屈辱
entries.en: to die rather than suffer disgrace; better death than insult
entries.notes: H 与 L 密合；R 栏对音（jīn zīn…）显有讹误，不影响释义。

entries.en: curtain; hanging screen (door curtain)
entries.notes: L「Antesquesa . bou」难辨（疑涉门帘／布帘），释义仅据 H「帘」与 R「liên」。

entries.en: pavilion; open kiosk
entries.notes: L 栏全残；M、R 对音支持 H「亭」，第二音节未明。

entries.en: secret; private matter
entries.notes: L 不可解，M、R 对音与 H 不合，H 复有「秘密／私房」两读之疑，义难定。
